```{r Check Elko Tiles}
elko_excluded_footprint_sf$geometry <- st_sfc(lapply(seq_len(nrow(elko_excluded_footprint_table)), function(i) {
  st_polygon(list(matrix(
    c(elko_excluded_footprint_table$xmin[i], elko_excluded_footprint_table$ymin[i],
      elko_excluded_footprint_table$xmax[i], elko_excluded_footprint_table$ymin[i],
      elko_excluded_footprint_table$xmax[i], elko_excluded_footprint_table$ymax[i],
      elko_excluded_footprint_table$xmin[i], elko_excluded_footprint_table$ymax[i],
      elko_excluded_footprint_table$xmin[i], elko_excluded_footprint_table$ymin[i]),
    ncol=2, byrow=TRUE
  )))
}), crs=crs_lidar)

excluded_tiles_that_should_intersect <- lengths(st_intersects(elko_excluded_footprint_sf, south_hills_polygon_in_target_crs)) > 0

cat("Excluded Elko tiles that actually intersect South Hills:", sum(excluded_tiles_that_should_intersect), "\n")

```

## Classification

We now have the South Hills and Albions as separate files containing their own filtered products - though file naming scheme was kept consistent. We can now classify both of these.

```{r Full Area - Classification}

##### 0) Define directories FIRST #####

# Albion (assumes albion_run_root_directory + albion_filtered_output_directory already exist in your session)
albion_ground_output_directory <- file.path(albion_run_root_directory, "02_ground_csf")
albion_log_directory           <- file.path(albion_run_root_directory, "logs")

# South Hills
southhills_run_root_directory        <- "R:/CACR_HSM_LiDAR/Output_Files/FullArea_Run"
southhills_filtered_output_directory <- file.path(southhills_run_root_directory, "01_filtered")
southhills_ground_output_directory   <- file.path(southhills_run_root_directory, "02_ground_csf")
southhills_log_directory             <- file.path(southhills_run_root_directory, "logs")

dir.create(albion_ground_output_directory,     recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(albion_log_directory,               recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(southhills_ground_output_directory, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(southhills_log_directory,           recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)


##### 1) Pre-Classification Checks #####

albion_filtered_files <- list.files(
  albion_filtered_output_directory,
  pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

southhills_filtered_files <- list.files(
  southhills_filtered_output_directory,
  pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
)

stopifnot(length(albion_filtered_files) > 0)
stopifnot(length(southhills_filtered_files) > 0)

stopifnot(all(file.exists(albion_filtered_files)))
stopifnot(all(file.exists(southhills_filtered_files)))

header_ok <- function(f) {
  h <- try(lidR::readLASheader(f), silent = TRUE)
  !inherits(h, "try-error")
}

stopifnot(all(vapply(albion_filtered_files[1:min(10, length(albion_filtered_files))], header_ok, logical(1))))
stopifnot(all(vapply(southhills_filtered_files[1:min(10, length(southhills_filtered_files))], header_ok, logical(1))))

cat("Albion existing CSF outputs:",
    length(list.files(albion_ground_output_directory, pattern="\\.(las|laz)$", ignore.case=TRUE)), "\n")
cat("South Hills existing CSF outputs:",
    length(list.files(southhills_ground_output_directory, pattern="\\.(las|laz)$", ignore.case=TRUE)), "\n")


##### 2) Define CSF algorithm object #####

csf_ground_fullArea <- lidR::csf(
  sloop_smooth     = TRUE,
  class_threshold  = 0.5,
  cloth_resolution = 0.5,
  rigidness        = 2
)


##### 3) Study area run list #####

study_area_run_list <- list(
  list(
    study_area_name = "Albion",
    filtered_dir    = albion_filtered_output_directory,
    ground_dir      = albion_ground_output_directory,
    log_dir         = albion_log_directory
  ),
  list(
    study_area_name = "SouthHills",
    filtered_dir    = southhills_filtered_output_directory,
    ground_dir      = southhills_ground_output_directory,
    log_dir         = southhills_log_directory
  )
)


##### 4) Helper: list filtered tiles #####

list_filtered_tile_paths <- function(filtered_directory_path) {
  list.files(
    path = filtered_directory_path,
    pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )
}


##### 5) Helper: detect valid CSF outputs (resume-safe) #####
## DONE means:
##  - matching output exists (stem_csf OR stem_<anything>_csf)
##  - AND output header is readable (so partial/broken files get re-run)

detect_valid_csf_outputs <- function(filtered_tile_paths, ground_dir) {

  ground_outputs_full <- list.files(
    ground_dir,
    pattern = "\\.(las|laz)$",
    full.names = TRUE,
    ignore.case = TRUE
  )

  if (length(ground_outputs_full) == 0) {
    return(rep(FALSE, length(filtered_tile_paths)))
  }

  ground_outputs_base <- basename(ground_outputs_full)
  filtered_stems      <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(filtered_tile_paths))

  has_valid_output <- vapply(filtered_stems, function(stem) {

    # Escape regex metacharacters in stem
    stem_escaped <- gsub("([\\.^$|()\\[\\]{}*+?\\\\])", "\\\\\\1", stem)

    # Match:
    #   ^stem_csf.las
    #   ^stem_<anything>_csf.las
    pattern <- paste0("^", stem_escaped, "(_.*)?_csf\\.(las|laz)$")

    idx <- which(grepl(pattern, ground_outputs_base, ignore.case = TRUE))
    if (length(idx) == 0) return(FALSE)

    # At least one candidate must be readable
    any(vapply(ground_outputs_full[idx], function(out_path) {
      h <- try(lidR::readLASheader(out_path), silent = TRUE)
      !inherits(h, "try-error")
    }, logical(1)))

  }, logical(1))

  has_valid_output
}


##### 6) Helper: build CSF worker function #####

make_csf_ground_function <- function(study_area_name, log_directory_path, csf_algorithm_object) {

  dir.create(log_directory_path, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  csf_error_log_path <- file.path(log_directory_path, paste0(study_area_name, "_csf_ground_errors.txt"))

  function(cluster, ...) {
    tryCatch({

      las_object <- lidR::readLAS(cluster)
      if (is.null(las_object) || lidR::is.empty(las_object)) return(NULL)

      las_object <- lidR::classify_ground(las_object, csf_algorithm_object)

      las_object

    }, error = function(e) {

      cat(
        format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"),
        "- ", study_area_name, " CSF ERROR:",
        conditionMessage(e),
        "\n",
        file = csf_error_log_path,
        append = TRUE
      )

      NULL
    })
  }
}


##### 7) MAIN LOOP: resume where it left off #####

for (single_run in study_area_run_list) {

  study_area_name <- single_run$study_area_name
  filtered_dir    <- single_run$filtered_dir
  ground_dir      <- single_run$ground_dir
  log_dir         <- single_run$log_dir

  cat("\n==============================\n")
  cat("Running CSF ground classification for:", study_area_name, "\n")
  cat("Filtered inputs:", filtered_dir, "\n")
  cat("Ground outputs :", ground_dir, "\n")
  cat("==============================\n\n")

  filtered_tile_paths <- list_filtered_tile_paths(filtered_dir)

  if (length(filtered_tile_paths) == 0) {
    warning("No filtered tiles found for ", study_area_name, " in: ", filtered_dir)
    next
  }

  cat(study_area_name, "filtered tiles found:", length(filtered_tile_paths), "\n")

  # Resume-safe skip logic
  already_done_logical <- detect_valid_csf_outputs(filtered_tile_paths, ground_dir)
  remaining_tile_paths <- filtered_tile_paths[!already_done_logical]

  cat(study_area_name, "tiles already ground-classified (valid):", sum(already_done_logical), "\n")
  cat(study_area_name, "tiles remaining to classify            :", length(remaining_tile_paths), "\n")

  saveRDS(
    remaining_tile_paths,
    file.path(log_dir, paste0(study_area_name, "_remaining_tiles_to_csf.rds"))
  )

  if (length(remaining_tile_paths) == 0) {
    message("All tiles already have valid CSF outputs for ", study_area_name, ". Skipping.")
    next
  }

  ctg_remaining <- lidR::readLAScatalog(remaining_tile_paths)
  lidR::opt_chunk_size(ctg_remaining)   <- 0
  lidR::opt_chunk_buffer(ctg_remaining) <- 0

  # Keep naming consistent with existing outputs like:
  # USGS_..._filtered_260_csf.las
  lidR::opt_output_files(ctg_remaining) <- file.path(
    ground_dir,
    "{ORIGINALFILENAME}_{ID}_csf"
  )

  options(lidR.cores = 8)
  lidR::set_lidr_threads(1)

  csf_worker_function <- make_csf_ground_function(
    study_area_name      = study_area_name,
    log_directory_path   = log_dir,
    csf_algorithm_object = csf_ground_fullArea
  )

  csf_apply_result <- lidR::catalog_apply(ctg_remaining, csf_worker_function)
  print(csf_apply_result)

  cat("\nCSF classification finished for ", study_area_name, ". Outputs in:\n", ground_dir, "\n")
}

  las_chk <- lidR::readLAS(one_out)
```
